set.body:
Objective
Record training/read origin dependencies and holdout access at the scientific plan boundary, including analyst-selected probes and data-dependent spatial/temporal preparation.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements FND-04, FND-06, INF-05. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
scope integration; evidence read-scope adapter; predictive assessments; fMRI readout provenance bridge. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M1.05, M1.06. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Observation splits retain upstream acquisition/readout/filter support; cross-boundary smoothing or HRF fitting invalidates an unsupported locality/independence claim.
2. Inspecting outer scores and selecting a model/ROI is recorded as adaptive exposure; the same evidence cannot remain an untouched confirmation set.
3. Unapproved cost probes cannot read holdout payloads; approved access is explicit, budgeted and exposure-recorded.
4. Ledger references existing provenance objects rather than creating a global mutable registry or blocking metadata-only inspection.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
sbt mvpaFitJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaFitJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M1.09: Track read origins, temporal support, and adaptive holdout exposure
